[中文](#cn-v0.5.0) | [English](#en-v0.5.0)
**让 AI「知道该用哪个工具」。** 起因是一次**示例弹窗一比一还原的实战复盘**：AI 走了
`summary → format=full 落盘 → 自己写 python 解析 43 图层 → 手算 8 类数值` 的弯路。
复盘结论是 —— **插件的能力早就够了**（`read_blocks` / `region+gapMaxDistance` / `verify_blocks` 都在），
**缺的是"让 AI 知道该用它们"**。所以这一版的重心是**注入**，外加把结果里缺的几列补上。
<h3 id="cn-v0.5.0">新增功能</h3>
- **`SYSTEM_HINT` 重写**（5 行 → **21 行**，五段）：**选工具**决策树（还原布局→`read_blocks`、区域取数→
  `region+gapMaxDistance`、坐标映射→`mapBox/toBox`、只要统计→`format=tokens`、验收→`verify_blocks`，
  并明确「**别 summary 不够就转 full 再自己写脚本解析**」）、**换算**（`rpx = px × 750 ÷ 画板宽`，别写死 ×2）、
  **以稿为准**（字重 400 就是 400 / 间距用稿里的 / 半透明按 alpha 别换实色 / **切图块没有填充也没有圆角但尺寸要还原**）、
  **溯源**（记 version）、**定位**（贴整条链接 + 项目档案）。
- **「间距一览」段**（`read_blocks` 末尾，可直接抄 CSS）：块间**最近边距 + 方向**（`↕`/`↔`，只在另一轴有重叠时算），
  外加一类**「齐平」**（两条边重合）—— 后者是「说明块底 ≡ 头像底」那种关系，单靠间距给不出。
- **色值直出两种形式**：`#574af4@10% (rgba(87, 74, 244, 0.1))` —— 保留原串便于回查，同时给可直接粘贴的写法。
- **双单位输出**：`120×152px / 240×304rpx`，换算比**按画板宽度算**（宽 375 即 ×2），表头写明基准。
  默认只在**「间距一览」与 `region`**（要直接抄进 CSS 的两处）；宽表要 `dualUnits` / `--dual-units` 才开。
- **尾注**：`≈5.52KB；本稿 21 块` + 一行「下一步该用什么」，把决策树**同时**放进结果里。
- **标题行带 meta**：`# 示例弹窗（375×812） ｜version=88e0aaa6｜更新于 2026-09-17`（**拿不到就不打，不许编**）。
<h3 id="cn-v0.5.0">体验优化</h3>
- **间距段的口径**（按"省上下文"目标调过，且写在表头）：**封顶 24 行 · 按距离从紧到松排 · 贴边 0px 不计入** ——
  否则 610 层的大稿会出 **315 条**"文字碎片紧挨着"的 0px 行，把真正的竖向节奏挤出前几行，表就不可抄了。
  大稿实测间距段只占 **25%**（小稿 44%），**不随稿子线性膨胀**。
- **复用**（不写第二份实现）：换算复用 verify 的 `toTarget` 公式、rgba 复用 `rgbaString`（hex→rgb 复用 `parseColor`）、
  间距几何复用 `geometricGaps`。
<h3 id="cn-v0.5.0">问题修复</h3>
**四个真 bug，其中两个影响已发布的功能：**
- ⭐ **`geometricGaps` 的"每方向只留最近一条"是按 `id` 做键的** —— 调用方不给 id（或 id 重复，如 Figma 的
  `I37:2804;3`）时**所有元素挤在同一个键上 → 大部分间距关系被静默丢掉**（4 元素夹具本该 5 条只出 2 条，
  **看着像"这里就这点间距"**）→ 内部键改用元素身份。**这条影响已发布的 `region+gapMaxDistance`。**
- ⭐ **画板自己被当成元素**（`depth=0`，坐标是**画布绝对**的 `-12638`，而子层是画板相对）→ 间距表冒出
  **`12279px / 24558rpx` 的垃圾数字**（AI 会照抄）→ 排除 `depth===0`，修后同一稿全落在 `2px…45.85px`。
- **更新时间是 RFC-2822 原文**（`Thu, 17 Sep 2026`）被切出残句 → 复用现成的 `parseRfc2822` 归一。
- **齐平段出现"自己跟自己对齐"**（验收回放时抓到）：真身是**父子**（子层是父层的 `:shadow`、几乎撑满，
  四条边全落在容差内）**再叠一层渲染歧义**（名字截到 22 字后两个元素撞成同一前缀）。
  → 新增 `sameElement()` / `isAncestor()` **先于边界判定**排除，并给显示名去歧义（撞名补 `#d<深度>`）。
  **11 条噪声 → 6 条真关系。**
<h3 id="cn-v0.5.0">其他变更</h3>
- 自检 **611 → 651 项**（+40）；变异测试四组全红。
- **如实记录的未验证项**：`region` 的双单位只做了代码级接入、**未跑真机**；「无填充无圆角的切图块」
  **今日真机上不存在那个形态**（3 个 `Cert Icon` 都有 `radius=6`），该场景是把真机图层的 radius 抹掉复现后验的
  （合成断言 ✔ / 真机复现 ✔ / **真机原生 ✘**）；齐平的容差（0.5px）是本次定的，**没做统计意义上的"该报的都报了"验证**。

**Full Changelog**: [v0.4.4...v0.5.0](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.4.4...v0.5.0)

---

<h3 id="en-v0.5.0">New Features</h3>
- **`SYSTEM_HINT` rewritten** (5 lines → **21 lines**, five sections): a **tool decision tree** (block layout →
  `read_blocks`; a region's precise numbers → `region+gapMaxDistance`; coordinate mapping → `mapBox/toBox`;
  statistics only → `format=tokens`; acceptance → `verify_blocks`; plus an explicit
  "**do not fall back to `format=full` and write your own parser**"), **unit conversion**
  (`rpx = px × 750 ÷ artboard width`, never a hardcoded ×2), **follow the artboard** (weight 400 is 400 / use the
  artboard's spacing / keep the alpha instead of a similar-looking solid / **image blocks have neither fill nor
  radius but their size still matters**), **provenance** (record `version`), and **locating** (paste the whole link).
- **"Spacing at a glance" section** (appended to `read_blocks`, ready to copy into CSS): nearest edge distance
  **and direction** between blocks (`↕`/`↔`, only when the other axis overlaps), plus a **"flush"** category
  (two edges coinciding) — the latter is the "explanation block bottom ≡ avatar bottom" relationship that
  spacing alone cannot express.
- **Colours in both forms**: `#574af4@10% (rgba(87, 74, 244, 0.1))` — the original string for lookup plus a
  paste-ready form.
- **Dual units**: `120×152px / 240×304rpx`, computed **from the artboard width** (375-wide ⇒ ×2), with the basis
  stated in the header. On by default only in **the spacing section and `region`**; wide tables need
  `dualUnits` / `--dual-units`.
- **Footer**: `≈5.52KB；本稿 21 块` plus a one-line "what to use next", putting the decision tree in the result too.
- **Title line carries meta**: `# 示例弹窗（375×812） ｜version=88e0aaa6｜更新于 2026-09-17` (**omitted, never invented, when unavailable**).
<h3 id="en-v0.5.0">Improvements</h3>
- **Spacing rules**, tuned for context economy and stated in the header: **capped at 24 rows · sorted from
  tightest to loosest · flush (0px) excluded** — otherwise a 610-layer artboard emits **315** zero-pixel
  "text fragment touching text fragment" rows and pushes the real vertical rhythm out of the first lines,
  making the table useless to copy. On a large artboard this section is only **25%** of the output (44% on a
  small one) — it does **not** grow linearly with the artboard.
- **Reuse, not reimplementation**: conversion reuses verify's `toTarget` formula, rgba reuses `rgbaString`
  (hex→rgb reuses `parseColor`), and the spacing geometry reuses `geometricGaps`.
<h3 id="en-v0.5.0">Bug Fixes</h3>
**Four real bugs, two of them affecting already-shipped features:**
- ⭐ **`geometricGaps` keyed "nearest per direction" by `id`** — when the caller supplies no id, or ids collide
  (e.g. Figma's `I37:2804;3`), **every element collapses onto one key and most spacing relations are silently
  dropped** (a 4-element fixture that should yield 5 relations yielded 2 — **it looks like "that is all the
  spacing there is"**) → keyed by element identity now. **This one affects the shipped `region+gapMaxDistance`.**
- ⭐ **The artboard itself was treated as an element** (`depth=0`; its coordinates are **canvas-absolute**
  `-12638` while children are artboard-relative) → the spacing table emitted a **`12279px / 24558rpx` garbage
  number** (which an AI would copy) → `depth===0` excluded; the same artboard now stays within `2px…45.85px`.
- **The updated-at value is raw RFC-2822** (`Thu, 17 Sep 2026`) and was sliced into the fragment `Thu, 17 Se` →
  normalised through the existing `parseRfc2822`.
- **The flush section paired elements with their own edges** (caught during acceptance replay): the real cause is
  **parent/child** (the child is the parent's `:shadow`, nearly filling it, so all four edges fall inside the
  tolerance) **compounded by a rendering ambiguity** (names truncated to 22 characters collide into one prefix).
  → `sameElement()` / `isAncestor()` now run **before** any edge comparison, and display names are disambiguated
  (collisions get `#d<depth>`). **11 noisy rows → 6 real relations.**
<h3 id="en-v0.5.0">Chores</h3>
- Self-check **611 → 651 assertions** (+40); all four mutation groups turn red.
- **Honestly recorded as unverified**: `region`'s dual units are wired at code level but were **not exercised on a
  real artboard**; the "image block with neither fill nor radius" **does not exist in today's artboards**
  (all three `Cert Icon` layers carry `radius=6`), so that scenario was validated by **erasing the radius on real
  layers** (synthetic assertion ✔ / real-machine reproduction ✔ / **native real-machine ✘**); and the flush
  tolerance (0.5px) was chosen here, with **no statistical validation that everything reportable is reported**.
**Full Changelog**: [v0.4.4...v0.5.0](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.4.4...v0.5.0)
